name: The Grave Knight
label: Quest
description: Melisara in Tarren Mill asks you to confront Atrexis, a necromancer raising the dead beneath Dalaran. She sees his work as an affront to the Forsaken.
intro: Melisara in Tarren Mill asks you to confront Atrexis, a necromancer raising the dead beneath Dalaran. She sees his work as an affront to the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.
I care not for the fate of the mage city, friend, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
